authorization.scope: same noncommercial public MVP scope as the accepted official GNM package

features.description: Tip projection ahead of the alar base, landmarks 30 vs 31/35
Nasal bridge ahead of the inner canthi, landmarks 28 vs 39/42
Mouth corners above the inner lip midline, landmarks 48/54 vs 62/66
Outer canthus above inner canthus, landmarks 36/39 and 45/42
Brow ridge ahead of the upper lid, landmarks 19/37 and 24/44
Brow above the upper lid, landmarks 19/37 and 24/44
Ear top to lobule bottom (fixed template vertices)
Outer helix beyond the face contour (fixed vertices vs landmarks 0/16)

fields.derivation: official upper_lip | lower_lip, 2 mesh smoothing passes
official mouth_sock, 1 smoothing pass
official teeth (vs gums) inside the teeth components, 1 smoothing pass
official eye_exteriors (transparent cornea shell)
angle from the gaze axis (sclera sphere fit center -> official pupil centroid) per eye; 180 outside the eyes
official nose, infraorbital, cheek and zygomatic regions on the exterior skin, 3 smoothing passes
official ears, 1 smoothing pass
official eye_sockets, 1 smoothing pass
height above a smooth baseline hairline h(azimuth) anchored to the official forehead region and ears; -64 on ears and non-exterior skin
cosine of the azimuth around the vertical head axis through the ear centroid (1 = face, -1 = nape); continuous, unlike the azimuth
height above the open neck boundary at the same azimuth
distance to a fixed vertical segment through the subject-left brow (landmark 25)
arc-length parameter along the same-side brow landmarks (0 = inner end 21/22, 1 = outer end 17/26), linearly extrapolated; continuous
vertical offset from the same-side brow landmark polyline at the closest point; continuous
official cheek and zygomatic regions, 3 smoothing passes
official hockey_mask, 2 smoothing passes
height above the cheek line anchored to landmarks 33, 48/54, 2/14 and the ear front
height above the neck line (jaw contour landmarks 2..14 lowered 22-30 mm)
x offset from the mouth center (landmarks 48/54); continuous, gated by scalpFront at runtime
y offset from the inner lip midline (landmarks 62/66); continuous, gated by scalpFront at runtime

format.fieldEncoding: uint8 per source vertex, value = min + u8 / 255 * (max - min), field-major
format.vectorEncoding: int16 x,y,z per source vertex times one float32 scale per vector (meters)
format.vectorOrder: identity prior directions, then feature tail directions, then expression presets
format.vertexSpace: official GNM source vertex index; render vertices map through the render GLB sourceVertexIndicesAccessor

identity.conditioning: Matheron update c = c0 + Gn^T (Gn Gn^T + tau^2 I)^-1 (target + eta - Gn c0) over the active features; displacement = sum_{k<K} c_k B_k + sum_f w_f tail_f
identity.prior: independent unit Gaussian per official head identity coefficient (GNM docs: typical range -3..3)
identity.unsampledComponents: head_032..head_169 only move along the feature directions; eyes_000..002 and teeth_000..079 stay at the template

notes: Derived offline from official GNM Head v3.0 data. Identity geometry is sampled from the official prior and conditioned on landmark-measured features; no official textures are included and fields are procedural painting coordinates.

landmarks.note: upstream 0ae8cc7 reverses lines 3-7 (anchors 2-6) so the jaw contour 0..16 is continuous (300-W iBUG 68 order); vertex topology is unchanged
